digest.component_or_area: live-DC test harness and probe workflows
propositions: serverInfo HTTP 200 does not guarantee that GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) have been registered, causing timing flakes to be misattributed to image degradation
the harness readiness gate polls only /rest/api/2/serverInfo and never verifies the required field inventory exists before declaring readiness
probe workflow and harness workflow diverged after partial fix in 1387, with probe checking fields but harness still checking only serverInfo
a system-only field inventory (27 fields, zero customfield_* entries) observed one second after serverInfo green indicates plugin has not yet initialized, not that the image lacks the feature
the weak readiness gate must be replaced with verification of every _REQUIRED_FIELDS name present in /rest/api/2/field response, with bounded budget and self-diagnosing inventory dump on expiry
